catalog_error_fetch: Could not download {file} from the catalog.
export_invalid: The end lies before the start.
export_text: No global dates file is loaded, so choose the period to export. Classes are expanded week by week, one calendar entry per date.
footer_note: Client-only. All data stays in your browser.
grid_empty: Add a timetable to your profile to see it here.
groups_export_link_long: The selection is too long for a link. Download the profile file instead.
import_error: Not a valid share link or profile file.
import_offline_warning: Some timetables are missing on this device. They may be available online once you are back on the network.
import_text: Paste a share link or choose a profile file. The import always creates a new profile.
picker_add_text: Choose the timetables to copy into this profile. Copies are yours: an update is only ever applied when you ask for it.
picker_new_text: Choose the timetables the new profile starts with. It gets its own copy of each one.
picker_none: No timetables to choose from yet. Upload one here.
picker_offline_warning: You are offline. Catalog timetables are not listed until you are back online.
profile_delete_text: “{name}”, its timetable copies and its group selection are removed from this device. Other profiles keep theirs.
profile_description: Each profile is a saved variant of your timetables.
profile_name_taken: A profile with this name already exists.
profile_rename_text: The name appears in the profile list, in downloaded file names and as the calendar name of the export.
share_warning_description: Your friend can't open these timetables from the link alone. Download them and send the files along with the link.
subject_catalog_warning: “{timetable}” comes from the catalog. Once you save a change, it no longer receives catalog updates.
subject_delete_text: {subject} is removed from “{timetable}”. This cannot be undone.
subject_dialog_text: Changes apply to “{timetable}” in this profile only.
subject_error_duplicate: This timetable already holds exactly this subject.
subject_error_group: Write the group as category.index, e.g. 2.1, or leave it empty.
subject_error_time: Every end has to come after its start.
toast_catalog_degrees_updated: Subject names updated from the catalog.
toast_catalog_dates_updated: Updated the global dates from the catalog.
toast_catalog_locations_updated: Room information updated from the catalog.
toast_ics_empty: Nothing to export in this period.
toast_ics_failed: Could not build the calendar file.

match.countPlural=one: {count} class has no fixed weekday and is not in the file.
match.countPlural=other: {count} classes have no fixed weekday and are not in the file.

toast_ics_undated_hint: Block, by arrangement or Saturday: {classes}. Give them dates (Edit subject) to include them.
tree_catalog_current: Up to date with the catalog
tree_catalog_offline: Offline: catalog updates cannot be checked
tree_description: Try out different subject variations for this profile.
tree_empty: Groups appear here once the profile holds a timetable.
tree_pick_ungrouped: Choose single classes without a group
tree_remove_text: “{name}” and its group selection are removed from this profile. Other profiles keep their copy.
tree_rename_taken: This profile already holds a timetable with that name.
name_invalid_chars: Names cannot contain {chars}: they become file names.
name_invalid_end: Names cannot end with a dot.
name_invalid_reserved: “{name}” is a reserved file name on Windows.
name_invalid_long: This name is too long for a file name.
update_from_catalog: The catalog serves a new version of {file}.
upload_error_dates_shape: does not match the expected global dates format:
upload_error_shape: does not match the expected timetable format:
upload_error_storage: Your browser refused to save the profile; the change will be gone after a reload.
warn_multi_group_in_category: More than one group selected in category {category} for {subjects}: {groups}.
warn_non_overlap: Selected groups do not overlap: {group} does not fit.
warn_sh_range: Date range unclear for SH1/SH2 subjects.
backup_error: This is no backup of this app, or it is damaged. Nothing was changed.
backup_restore_text: Profiles, dates and settings on this device are replaced by the backup. Profiles now: {current}, in the backup: {count}.
ios_hint: Add Zeiteisen to your home screen: Safari deletes the data of websites you have not opened for 7 days.
profile_duplicate_text: The copy gets every timetable and the whole group selection of this profile. It starts unlocked.
subject_on_demand_hint: Only takes place if enough students sign up.
import_missing_hint: Ask whoever sent you the link for the missing timetable files. They can download each one with the button next to the timetable's name.
data_own_hint: Your own dates and locations replace the catalog's, an own degree program replaces the catalog's of the same name. The catalog never updates your own files.
upload_own_no_updates: The catalog no longer updates them until you switch back to the catalog.
upload_error_locations_shape: does not match the expected locations format:
upload_error_degree_shape: does not match the expected degree program format:
upload_degrees_precedence: Each replaces the catalog's degree program of the same name. A subject uses the one it names as its degree program. The catalog never changes your own files.
toast_own_degrees_removed: Own degree programs removed; the catalog's apply again.
toast_catalog_dates_removed: Global dates from the catalog removed.
catalog_mode_ignore_text: The catalog is not read at all: no ready-made timetables, no timetable updates, and none of its dates, locations or degree programs.
catalog_mode_auto_text: Dates, locations and degree programs from the catalog are kept up to date. Timetables never update by themselves.
catalog_mode_freeze_text: Dates, locations and degree programs from the catalog stay as they are on this device. Its timetables are still offered.
catalog_url_text: Where the app reads the catalog from: the address of a folder holding its index.json. A server other than this site's has to allow it with CORS headers. Switching drops the previous catalog's data from this device; your own files stay.
catalog_url_invalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
degrees_manage_text: Each replaces the catalog's degree program of the same name; subjects use the one they name as their degree program.
skill_text: This AI skill turns the university's documents into files for this app: a timetable PDF into a .timetable file, abbreviation lists and module handbooks into a .degree file per degree program, the semester dates page into dates and the locations page into locations. Upload a .timetable file under “Add timetables”, everything else in the Data menu.
skill_steps_claude: Claude: Settings → Capabilities → Skills, upload the zip.
skill_steps_other: Other AI apps with skill support: import the zip.
skill_steps_chat: Otherwise: attach the zip to a chat together with your document.
skill_check: AI can make mistakes. The skill asks instead of guessing, but check its results before you rely on them.
picker_skill_link: Let an AI create one from the timetable PDF.
app_error_text: Part of the app could not be loaded, probably because a new version was published. Your data is safe on this device.
app_error_help: If reloading does not help: save a backup, then delete what keeps the app from starting.
degree_names_text: Give each file the name subjects use as their degree program, e.g. B-ABC. It replaces the catalog's degree program of that name.
degree_name_duplicate: Another file already has this name.
degree_name_replaces: Replaces your degree program loaded under this name.
data_delete_text: Choose what to delete from this device. This cannot be undone; the app starts again afterwards.
data_delete_profiles_text: Every profile with its timetables and group selection.
data_delete_files_text: The semester dates and your own locations and degree programs.
data_delete_catalog_text: What was downloaded from the catalog; the catalog hands it out again.
data_delete_settings_text: Catalog mode and URL (the catalog cache with them), hints already shown, the height of the notes.
data_delete_all: Everything selected: this device forgets the app, as on a first visit.
data_delete_error: Your browser refused to delete the data.
data_delete_app_text: The app is downloaded again on the next start; that needs a connection.
notes_text: On this device only, never in a link or a profile file. Links open on click, lines starting with “- [ ] ” become checkboxes.
notes_error_storage: Your browser refused to save the notes; the change will be gone after a reload.
notes_upload: Upload notes from a text file
notes_upload_text: Your notes on this device are replaced by the text in {file}.
